metadata.indication: Adults with advanced unresectable or metastatic melanoma; ECOG 0–2. Adults with advanced renal cell carcinoma after prior therapy; histologically confirmed advanced/metastatic RCC and at least one prior anti-angiogenic tyrosine kinase inhibitor; ECOG 0–2. Adults with relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma after autologous stem cell transplant and brentuximab vedotin; ECOG 0–1. IV only; SC is not approved for this indication. Adults with recurrent or metastatic squamous cell head and neck carcinoma progressing on or after platinum; oral cavity, pharynx or larynx, not amenable to curative local therapy; progression or recurrence within 6 months of last platinum; ECOG 0–1. Adults with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC after prior chemotherapy; recurrence or progression during or after one prior platinum-containing doublet for advanced/metastatic disease; ECOG 0–1. Adults with melanoma involving lymph nodes or metastatic disease completely resected; stage III or completely resected stage IV; excludes uveal melanoma; ECOG 0–1. Adults with residual pathological oesophageal or gastro-oesophageal junction cancer after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy; stage II/III predominantly adenocarcinoma or squamous carcinoma, platinum chemoradiotherapy then surgery; commence within 16 weeks of surgery; ECOG 0–1. Adults with high-risk muscle invasive urothelial carcinoma after radical resection within 4 months, PD-L1 tumour cells ≥1% by validated assay and unsuitable for adjuvant platinum. High risk pT3–4a or pT0/x–4a N+ without adjuvant cisplatin; pT2–4a or pT0/x–4a N+ after neoadjuvant cisplatin. Disease-free imaging within 4 weeks before start. Excludes partial cystectomy/nephrectomy and post-radical-surgery adjuvant systemic therapy or radiotherapy; ECOG 0–1.

eligibility: Adults with advanced unresectable or metastatic melanoma; ECOG 0–2.
Adults with advanced renal cell carcinoma after prior therapy; histologically confirmed advanced/metastatic RCC and at least one prior anti-angiogenic tyrosine kinase inhibitor; ECOG 0–2.
Adults with relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma after autologous stem cell transplant and brentuximab vedotin; ECOG 0–1. IV only; SC is not approved for this indication.

Adults with recurrent or metastatic squamous cell head and neck carcinoma progressing on or after platinum; oral cavity, pharynx or larynx, not amenable to curative local therapy; progression or recurrence within 6 months of last platinum; ECOG 0–1.
Adults with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC after prior chemotherapy; recurrence or progression during or after one prior platinum-containing doublet for advanced/metastatic disease; ECOG 0–1.
Adults with melanoma involving lymph nodes or metastatic disease completely resected; stage III or completely resected stage IV; excludes uveal melanoma; ECOG 0–1.

Adults with residual pathological oesophageal or gastro-oesophageal junction cancer after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy; stage II/III predominantly adenocarcinoma or squamous carcinoma, platinum chemoradiotherapy then surgery; commence within 16 weeks of surgery; ECOG 0–1.

Adults with high-risk muscle invasive urothelial carcinoma after radical resection within 4 months, PD-L1 tumour cells ≥1% by validated assay and unsuitable for adjuvant platinum. High risk pT3–4a or pT0/x–4a N+ without adjuvant cisplatin; pT2–4a or pT0/x–4a N+ after neoadjuvant cisplatin. Disease-free imaging within 4 weeks before start. Excludes partial cystectomy/nephrectomy and post-radical-surgery adjuvant systemic therapy or radiotherapy; ECOG 0–1.
Adequate haematological, hepatic and renal function.
exclusions: MIUC: partial cystectomy/nephrectomy or post-radical-surgery adjuvant systemic therapy/radiotherapy

Melanoma BRAF; MIUC validated PD-L1 assay
